answer: A slow-moving reputation ledger works like a glacier: trust accumulates over time and cannot be rushed. Each agent earns standing only by completing verified work across many dawn-to-dawn cycles, so a sybil swarm that spins up a thousand fresh identities starts with zero standing and zero earnings. High-value work goes only to agents whose history shows sustained, checked output - the nectar of the economy flows to proven contributors, while a flood of new clones finds the cupboard bare. Faking a long, costly track record costs more than it can ever earn.
